diagnosis: The controller queries MedicalRecord by an integer ID from the request URI without validating that the record belongs to the requesting patient or an attending physician with an active clinical assignment. An attacker can enumerate record IDs to extract confidential diagnoses, lab results, and medication histories across patients.
